english.title: Organise / take part in demonstration / public assembly likely interfere / obstruct - Manchester Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[organised]_
(B)_[took part in]_

a

(C)_[demonstration]_
(D)_[procession]_
(E)_[public assembly]_

at Manchester Airport

(F)_[which had not been pre-notified to and preapproved by the Airport Company]_
(G)_[which, in the opinion of a constable or airport official, could, or could continue to, obstruct or interfere with the proper use of the Airport, the safe or efficient use of the airport by a person or organisation or the comfort, convenience and/or safety of passengers or persons using the Airport]_
(H)_[which had not been pre-notified to and preapproved by the Airport Company and which, in the opinion of a constable or airport official, could, or could continue to, obstruct or interfere with the proper use of the airport, the safe or efficient use of the airport by a person or organisation or the comfort, convenience and/or safety of passengers or persons using the Airport]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 3.34 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
